summary: TAICCA reports 9,929 employees among 133 responding companies in its 2022 games survey, using public job-board data to fill some missing answers. This is a respondent-company sum with a broad value-chain scope, not a national workforce estimate. The 2023 and 2024 report landing pages were located, but their newer employment tables were not retrieved.

limitations: Not a national estimate and no stable panel established.
Overseas employee treatment and precise employee reference date not specified.
Missing-value imputation and active-firm selection affect representativeness.
Newer 2023/2024 report existence verified but employment tables remain unextracted.
No verified nationality or freelance shares.
